P.expected_type: ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [instK : Field K] (lam : ℤ) (V : Type*) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : Module ℂ V] (x : Module.End ℂ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (h_H001 : Nat.Prime p) (h_H002 : CharP K p) (h_H003 : 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < (p : ℤ)) (h_H004 : Module.Finite ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = lam.toNat+1 ∧ LR.Brackets x y h ∧ Nontrivial V ∧ ∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, LR.Inv W x → LR.Inv W y → LR.Inv W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) (h_H005 : v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = (lam : ℂ) • v) (h_H006 : (∃ f : Module.Basis (LR.Idx lam.toNat) ℤ M, ∃ c : Module.Basis (LR.Idx lam.toNat) ℂ V, ∀ i, (f i : V) = c i) ∧ (∀ r m, m ∈ M → LR.DP x r m ∈ M) ∧ (∀ r m, m ∈ M → LR.DP y r m ∈ M)), Nontrivial (LR.VK K M) ∧ ∃ o : LR.IntegralOps M x y h, ∀ W : Submodule K (LR.VK K M), LR.Inv W (o.xz.baseChange K) → LR.Inv W (o.yz.baseChange K) → LR.Inv W (o.hz.baseChange K) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤

correspondence.explanation: The parameters retain every prime p, arbitrary field K of characteristic p, integer lam in [0,p), complex module, highest-weight vector and arbitrary admissible lattice. The Chevalley brackets present sl2(C): a triple of endomorphisms satisfying them defines its action, and every original action gives such a triple. Common invariant subspaces express irreducibility; H004 retains dimension and H005 supplies the highest-weight vector. A Z-submodule of V is equivalently an additive subgroup. By H004 its simultaneous integer/complex basis can be reindexed by Fin(l+1); conversely H006 supplies such a basis. Stability under all divided powers is equivalent to stability under the Z-algebra they generate, by closure under sums and compositions. With 0≤lam, l=lam.toNat equals lam. The canonical tensor flip identifies K tensor_Z M with M tensor_Z K in both directions and intertwines the tensor-induced operators; VK uses only the scalar-first representation. IntegralOps records restrictions agreeing on every lattice element and inherited brackets: they are unique by injectivity of M into V, and T007 constructs them from H004/H006, so its existential witness adds no premise and denotes the actual induced action. Nontrivial means nonzero, and bottom/top mean zero/the whole space. Invariance under the three generators is equivalent to invariance under the image of L(K), since they span it and W is K-linear; this needs no faithful action and remains valid for p=2 and lam=0. No algebraic closure hypothesis is imposed.
